  (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked q.n q.dim) (seed : O.Seed 1 k),
      O.answer 1 k (0, x) seed = OracleTemplate.DobocK.localOracle q f x) →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (seed : (OracleTemplate.DobocK.dobocK q).Seed 1) (ξ : (j : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 j),
      OracleTemplate.execute O (OracleTemplate.DobocK.dobocK q) (fun x => k) seed ξ =
        OracleTemplate.DobocK.iterate q f k

                        (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f x -

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] (g : E → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 2 g →
    ∀ (L : ℝ),
      (∀ (x y : E), ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x - fderiv ℝ (gradient g) y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        ∀ (x y : E),
          g y ≤
            g x + inner ℝ (gradient g x) (y - x) + 1 / 2 * inner ℝ ((fderiv ℝ (gradient g) x) (y - x)) (y - x) +
              L / 6 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 3

                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f →
                  LongTails.Setups.DobocK.Assumption2 p.toPublic p.L f →
                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.StepSizeLemma5 p →
                      ∀ (xstar : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked p.n p.dim),
                        IsMinOn (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f) Set.univ xstar →
                          LongTails.Setups.DobocK.StepSizeTheorem2 p
                              (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) →
                            0 <
                                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.rate p
                                  (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) ∧

                                    (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                      LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) <
                                  1 ∧

                                  LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f
                                        (OracleTemplate.DobocK.iterate p.toPublic f k) -
                                      LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar ≤
                                    (1 -

                                            (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -

  LongTails.Setups.DobocK.Network p.toPublic →
    0 < p.lam →
      0 < p.η →
        1 ≤ p.K →
          0 < p.m →
            p.m ≤ p.M →
              0 ≤ p.L →
                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.Assumption1 p.toPublic p.m p.M f →
                  LongTails.Setups.DobocK.Assumption2 p.toPublic p.L f →
                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.StepSizeLemma5 p →
                      ∀ (xstar : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked p.n p.dim),
                        IsMinOn (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f) Set.univ xstar →
                          LongTails.Setups.DobocK.StepSizeTheorem2 p
                              (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) →
                            0 <
                                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.rate p
                                  (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) ∧
                              LongTails.Setups.DobocK.rate p
                                    (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                      LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) <
                                  1 ∧
                                ∀ (k : ℕ),
                                  LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f
                                        (OracleTemplate.DobocK.iterate p.toPublic f k) -
                                      LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar ≤
                                    (1 -
                                          LongTails.Setups.DobocK.rate p
                                            (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                              LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar)) ^
                                        k *
                                      (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                        LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar)
